Unstable ranking (tau=-0.06) suggests some models are improving while others degrade; error_trend weights should upweight improving models, complementing the robust median leader

Simple mean on full 19-model pool as direct counterpart to the median leader; tests whether robust aggregation (median) is genuinely helping with high error correlation (0.944) and unstable ranking (tau -0.06).
Median (robust to forecast outliers) on the top-7 pool (quality subset) - combines the two winning properties from a4 and a5

Different robust combiner (trimmed mean vs median) on the same 7-model pool; trims extreme forecasts to guard against one model occasionally diverging, motivated by unstable ranking (tau=-0.06) and high error correlation
Trend-dominated series with unstable rankings; DBA uses directional agreement which is a different mechanism than median/mean/weighted and may better capture the strong trend signal in pool4 models

decision.justification: Selected 'median on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9925. Series context: trend strength 0.7624 and seasonal strength 0.1505; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.06); 1 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.251.
